test_count.name: t
test_count.source: The first line contains an integer t (1 <= t <= 10^4) - the number of test cases

variables.name: n
variables.source: The only line of each test case contains an integer n (2 <= n <= 2 * 10^5) - the number of cards in the game

global_constraints.source: the sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 3 * 10^6
